On this walk you read the garden tomb as a milestone in imperial Mughal architecture.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Western gateway/axis
  • Water channels and paths
  • Mausoleum plinth
  • Surrounding tomb context

How the time is spent

  1. Western gateway/axis 25 min

    Read charbagh planning and Mughal dynastic symbolism.

    You: annotate quadrants

  2. Water channels and paths 35 min

    Identify garden geometry and hydraulic intent.

    You: sketch axes

  3. Mausoleum plinth 35 min

    Discuss double dome, octagonal plan and materials.

    You: mark elevation

  4. Surrounding tomb context 25 min

    Compare primary tomb and attached ensemble.

    You: compare two monuments

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Humayun’s Tomb using material evidence and a site map.
  • Read the garden tomb as a milestone in imperial Mughal architecture.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
